evidence: Rutherford backscattering analysis of HfAlO x shows a strong correlation between the number of ALD cycles of alumina and hafnia being alternated and the film composition. Grazing incidence X-ray diffraction analyses of thermally annealed films indicate that a higher Al concentration increases the crystallization temperature and degree of crystallization. TEM micrographs of 5-nm-thick as-deposited and annealed films shown in Fig. 5 reveal the amorphous nature of all films.
